1030.description: A machine fly where the arms sweep together in front, isolating the chest.
instructions: Sit on the pec deck with your back flat and the arms at chest level.
Place your forearms or hands on the pads with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze for a moment, then open slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep your shoulders down and back.

1094.description: A pull-up using your legs for help. It builds back and arms.
instructions: Hold the handles with feet on the floor.
Lean back.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Use your legs for light help.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

1158.description: Using the straps for support, you sink into a wide side stance to stretch the inner thighs.
instructions: Hold the handles and step your legs wide.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight.
Sit back into the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

1222.description: A chin-up with machine assistance and a narrow underhand grip. It lets you build pulling strength with less bodyweight.
instructions: Set the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

1286.description: A one-arm chest fly with your upper back on a stability ball. The wobbly base brings your core in while the chest does the work.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in one hand and your feet flat on the ground.
Walk your feet forward, rolling the ball until your upper back is supported on the ball and your head, neck, and shoulders are off the ball.
Extend your arm with the dumbbell straight up above your chest, palm facing inward.
Slowly lower the dumbbell out to the side, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Pause for a moment when your arm is parallel to the ground.
Engage your chest muscles to bring the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃，双脚平放在地上。
双脚向前走，滚动球，直到你的上背部受到球的支撑，并且你的头、脖子和肩膀离开球。
将手臂伸直，将哑铃举至胸部上方，手掌朝内。
慢慢地将哑铃向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停片刻。
启动胸部肌肉，将哑铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1350.description: A seated row on a lever machine with chest support. It works the upper back and lats with minimal lower back strain.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footrests to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet on the footrests.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement.
Slowly release the handles and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将座椅高度和脚踏板调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
正手握住手柄，距离与肩同宽。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢松开手柄并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1414.description: Rest your arm on a preacher bench and curl a dumbbell with an overhand grip. It targets the biceps and forearms with no body swing.
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your chest against the pad and your arm extended over the edge of the bench, holding a dumbbell with an underhand grip.
Lower the dumbbell slowly until your arm is fully extended.
Curl the dumbbell back up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师凳上，胸部靠在垫子上，手臂伸出长凳边缘，反握哑铃。
慢慢降低哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
将哑铃向后弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1478.description: A plank where your feet jump in and out like a jumping jack, combining core stability with cardio.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Jump your feet apart, then jump them back together.
Keep your upper body steady and your hips from rising.
Continue at a steady pace for the planned time.

1542.description: A stiff-legged deadlift performed while standing on a bench, giving you extra range of motion. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand on a sturdy bench holding a barbell at thigh level, feet hip-width apart.
Keep your knees almost straight and push your hips back.
Lower the bar toward your toes with a flat back as far as your hamstrings allow.
Pause briefly, then squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
Keep the bar close to your legs and stay in control throughout.

1606.description: A triceps pushdown with an underhand grip on an SZ bar. The reverse grip shifts the feel slightly and works the forearms too.
instructions: Attach an SZ bar to a high pulley and grip it palms up with hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly without letting your elbows drift forward.

1670.description: A standing one-arm dumbbell curl. It builds the biceps on one side at a time.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing forward and arm fully extended.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weight upward while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 站直，一手握哑铃，手掌朝前，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并向上弯曲重量，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1734.description: Triceps kickbacks on an exercise ball. It isolates the triceps and adds core demand.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing inwards and your arms bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arms straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
将手臂向后伸直，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1798.description: Lying flat and reaching long through your arms and legs gives your whole body a gentle stretch. A nice reset after training.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Reach your fingertips up and your toes down, as if you want to get taller.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1862.description: Seated machine press that builds the shoulders and triceps along a guided path.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Sit back with your feet flat and grip the handles.
Press upward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.

1926.description: A seated ankle stretch that lengthens the calf and the outer side of the lower leg.
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly outward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and outer ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1990.description: A stretch that eases the shoulder into outward rotation.
instructions: Stand next to a doorframe and bend your elbow to 90 degrees with your forearm on the frame.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow level with your shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2118.description: A seated side bend that stretches the sides of the waist and the lats.
instructions: Sit tall with your legs crossed or feet flat on the floor.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways away from it, placing the other hand on the floor for support.
Keep both sit bones grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2310.description: A kick where you turn your back to the target and thrust the heel straight back, building rotation and balance.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Pivot on your supporting foot.
Kick your leg straight back with the heel leading.
Keep your torso leaning slightly forward for balance.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

2566.description: A lying pullover with a bent elbow that stretches and works the chest, with help from the lats and triceps.
instructions: Lie back on a bench or the floor with knees bent and feet flat, holding one dumbbell over your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and lock that angle.
Lower the dumbbell back over your head in a slow arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pull the weight back over your chest along the same arc.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back from arching.

2758.description: Rising from a low squat against cable tension to train the glutes and legs.
instructions: Hold the cable handle at your chest and sit back into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall.
Push through your heels to stand fully.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

2950.description: A squat on a machine where the weight hangs from a belt at your hips. It loads the legs without stressing your spine.
instructions: Step into the belt and stand on the platforms with the belt snug on your hips.
Stand tall and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

3142.description: A sumo squat on a smith machine. Targets the glutes, inner thighs and quads.
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper back and shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃置于臀部高度的史密斯机上。
站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾朝外。
将自己置于杠铃下方，将其放在上背部和肩膀上。
当你将身体降低到蹲姿时，收紧核心并保持挺胸，将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖。
放低身体，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3270.description: Run in place and throw in a jumping jack every few steps for a full-body cardio burst.
instructions: Stand tall and start jogging on the spot.
After a few steps, jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together and lower the arms.
Resume running and repeat the pattern.
Keep your landings soft and keep going for 30-60 seconds.

3334.description: A one arm fly lying on the floor, a safe way to stretch and load the chest with a limited range.
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in one hand over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Open your arm out to the side until your upper arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbell back above you.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

3398.description: A lunge with dumbbells held at your shoulders, which challenges your legs and trunk.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push back to the start.
Alternate legs for each rep.

3462.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 2 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3526.description: A kneeling rotation drill for upper back mobility.
instructions: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow toward the opposite arm.
Open up and rotate toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

3590.description: Raise one leg at a time while lying on the floor, working the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg to about 90 degrees.
Lower it slowly and lift the other leg.
Alternate without arching your back.

3654.description: Lie under a barbell on a rack and pull your chest up to it for the back muscles.
instructions: Set a barbell on a rack at a height you can reach lying down.
Lie under it and grip the bar overhand.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to full extension.

3718.description: A lateral squat done from a split position, followed by a roll, for leg strength and coordination.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes forward.
Shift your weight to one side and squat on that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Roll back with control and roll up again.
Push back to the centre.
Alternate sides.

3782.description: A jumping lunge combined with a one-arm band row. It raises your heart rate and builds leg power.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a lunge position with your chest up.
Jump and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge and pull the handle to your ribs.
Keep your front knee over your ankle on each landing.
Switch rowing arm for the next set.

3910.description: A push-up wearing a weighted vest for extra load on the chest and triceps.
instructions: Put on a weighted vest and start in a plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Repeat for the set.

4038.description: One arm row with the end of a landmine bar. It builds the lats and mid back with a smooth arc.
instructions: Load the landmine bar and stand over it with a hip hinge, knees soft.
Grip the bar end with one hand and keep your back flat.
Pull the bar toward your hip, squeezing your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

4102.description: A chin up with added load, building pulling strength in your lats and biceps.
instructions: Attach the weight with a belt and grip the bar with palms facing you.
Hang with arms straight.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bar.
Lower under control to full extension.

4166.description: An explosive jump squat holding a trap bar. It develops lower body power.
instructions: Stand inside a trap bar with feet shoulder width apart.
Grip the handles and stand tall.
Squat down quickly with your chest up.
Jump up explosively off the floor.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset before the next rep.

4230.description: A Turkish get-up holding the bell upside down, moving only up to a kneeling position. It builds shoulder stability and core control.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell upside down in one hand, arm straight up.
Bend the same-side knee and plant the foot.
Roll onto your elbow, then your hand.
Lift your hips and sweep the straight leg back to kneel.
Reverse the steps slowly to lie down.
Keep your eyes on the bell and switch sides after your reps.

4294.description: A deep squat performed with your arms locked out overhead. It trains the legs while testing shoulder and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and raise both arms straight overhead.
Brace your core and keep your arms in line with your ears.
Sit your hips back and down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your arms locked overhead.

4358.description: A kneeling pulldown using a band anchored overhead. It builds the lats at home.
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel facing it, holding the ends.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control.

4422.description: A curl where the bar drags up your torso with elbows pulled back. It keeps tension on the biceps and reduces shoulder help.
instructions: Stand holding an ez bar with an underhand grip at your thighs.
Keep the bar close to your body.
Curl it up while moving your elbows back behind you.
Let the bar slide up your torso to chest height.
Lower slowly under control.

4486.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the back of the shoulder blade (infraspinatus). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your back of the shoulder blade (infraspinatus) while lying on your back on the floor.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4678.description: A hip-hinge swing using a resisted band. It builds hip power and glute strength.
instructions: Stand on the band holding the other end with both hands.
Hinge your hips back with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to swing your arms up to chest height.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Control the return and repeat.

4742.description: A hip thrust with a dumbbell across your hips. It is a direct way to build the glutes.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell across your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart, knees bent.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top with your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.

4806.description: A wide-grip pull from a seated start position. It trains the lats and upper back with a lower starting load than a full pull-up.
instructions: Sit under a pull-up bar and take a wide overhand grip.
Hang with arms extended and your chest lifted.
Pull your elbows down and toward your ribs to bring your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower yourself slowly to full arm extension.

4870.description: A side-lying clamshell opening of the knees. It strengthens the outer hips.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together.
Keep your feet touching.
Lift your top knee.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

4934.description: A plank done face up, with a slightly different arm setup. It strengthens the back of the body and the core.
instructions: Sit with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Press into your hands and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Keep your chin neutral.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

5062.description: A small nodding motion lying on your back. It trains the deep neck muscles and improves head posture.
instructions: Lie on your back with your head resting on the floor and knees bent.
Gently draw your chin toward your throat.
Press the back of your head lightly into the floor.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat.

5126.description: Twist your torso from side to side while standing. It warms up the trunk and works the obliques lightly.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, arms bent in front of your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body to one side.
Come back through the center and rotate the other way.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 20-30 twists.

5190.description: The classic Olympic lift. You clean the bar to your shoulders, then jerk it overhead.
instructions: Grip the bar just outside your knees with a flat back.
Pull explosively and drop under the bar, catching it on your shoulders.
Stand up fully and reset your feet.
Dip, drive, and split your legs as you punch the bar overhead.
Recover your feet and lower the bar with control.

5382.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the middle back. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your mid back, hands behind your head.
Place the roller under the middle back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly up and down.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5702.description: A deadlift performed while standing on a low platform. The longer range of motion trains the start of the pull and the legs.
instructions: Stand on a low plate or platform with the bar over mid-foot.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Flatten your back and brace your core.
Push the floor away and stand tall.
Lower the bar back under control.

5894.description: Seated stillness with a tall spine. Calms the mind and trains upright posture.
instructions: Sit comfortably cross-legged, with hips slightly higher than your knees.
Lengthen your spine and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your knees.
Close your eyes and settle into easy breathing.
Stay for 3-10 minutes.

6150.description: A concentration curl done with both arms at once, elbows braced on your thighs. It isolates the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet wide.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward.
Rest the backs of your upper arms on your inner thighs.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

6214.description: A lying scissor kick where the legs cross over each other. It trains the inner thighs and lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs lifted.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Open your legs wide.
Cross one leg over the other.
Open and cross the other leg on top.
Keep a steady rhythm.

6406.description: Curling an EZ bar over a preacher pad, which keeps your upper arms still so your biceps do the work.
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight and repeat.

6790.description: A simple check of how far the shoulder turns outward. Move slowly and stay in a pain-free range.
instructions: Stand or lie with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your elbow against your body.
Rotate your forearm outward slowly.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other arm.

6982.description: A full push-up focusing on wrist position and control. It builds the chest while preparing the wrists for load.
instructions: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Spread your fingers and keep your wrists stacked.
Lower your chest to the floor under control.
Press back to the top.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.

7558.description: Wall sit with heels raised for a tougher quad hold.
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your back on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your back flat.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Slide up carefully.

7622.description: Lie by a wall and rest one leg up against it to stretch the hamstring. Easy to relax into and good after leg days.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest one heel on the wall with your leg as straight as feels comfortable.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Relax and breathe, letting the hamstring lengthen.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

9606.description: A plyometric where you step off a box, land, and jump up immediately. It trains reactive strength in the legs.
instructions: Stand on the edge of a low box with feet hip-width apart.
Step off, do not jump, and land on both feet.
Absorb the landing by bending your knees and hips.
Immediately explode upward into a jump.
Land softly and reset.

9862.description: A one-arm curl on a plate-loaded preacher machine, isolating the biceps.
instructions: Sit at the machine with your upper arm resting on the pad and grip the handle.
Start with your arm almost straight.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

9990.description: An isometric hold pressing the inner forearm into a wall to work the shoulder rotators. There is no movement, only steady tension.
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Place the inside of your fist or forearm against the wall.
Press into the wall as if rotating your arm inward.
Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and rest briefly.
Keep your elbow at your side, then switch arms.

10054.description: A lunge held in one place with a barbell on your back, so the feet stay put while you lower and rise.
instructions: Place a barbell across your upper back.
Step into a split stance with one foot forward.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your chest tall and torso upright.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10118.description: A medicine ball slam combined with a circular sweep, building power through the core, lats and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart holding a medicine ball overhead.
Circle the ball to one side and around as you start to bend your knees.
Slam the ball hard into the floor in front of you.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up, and reset overhead.
Alternate the circle direction every set and keep your core braced.

10182.description: A burpee where you jump sideways over a dumbbell each rep, raising the heart rate and working the whole body.
instructions: Stand beside a dumbbell lying on the floor.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor, jump your feet back and do a push up.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Jump up and sideways over the dumbbell, landing softly.
Turn and repeat in the other direction at a steady pace.

10438.description: Hang from a bar and shift your weight from side to side. It decompresses the shoulders and stretches the lats.
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms long and your body relaxed.
Shift your weight toward one hand, letting that side stretch.
Shift to the other side and keep alternating.
Hold the hang for 20-30 seconds in total.

10566.description: From a half-kneeling stance, rotate your torso. It opens the spine and warms up the trunk.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Hold your arms crossed in front of your chest.
Rotate your upper body toward the front leg.
Return to the centre and keep your hips square.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

10758.description: A lateral hop from leg to leg while holding a medicine ball. It trains balance and side-to-side power.
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Hop sideways onto one leg.
Land softly with a bent knee.
Pause briefly, then push off to the other side.
Keep your chest up.
Alternate for the reps.

10950.description: A push-up hold on rings with arms fully extended. It demands shoulder stability and core tension.
instructions: Set the rings low and take a plank with your hands on them.
Keep your arms straight and rings close to your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and abs.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower to the floor to rest.

11014.description: A front raise with palms facing up. It targets the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows slightly soft.
Raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and avoid leaning back.

11270.description: A kneeling cable crunch that loads the abs. You curl your spine to bring your elbows toward your knees.
instructions: Kneel under a high pulley and hold the rope beside your head.
Keep your hips still.
Curl your torso down, bringing elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.

11654.description: A seated hip opener that lets one knee drop to the side to loosen the hips and inner thighs.
instructions: Sit tall on the floor or a bench with the soles of your feet together or one leg crossed in.
Let one knee drop slowly out to the side toward the floor.
Keep your back straight and your chest lifted as the knee lowers.
Pause briefly at the end of the comfortable range, then lift the knee back up.
Repeat for 8-12 reps per side.

11718.description: A chest-supported reverse fly on a plate-loaded lever machine that isolates the rear delts.
instructions: Sit with your chest against the incline pad and grab the handles.
Start with arms forward and slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

11782.description: A side-to-side jump that develops lateral power, balance and leg stability.
instructions: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent and your arms ready.
Push off and jump sideways, covering a comfortable distance.
Land softly on both feet with your knees tracking over your toes.
Immediately jump back to the starting side.
Keep your chest up and repeat for the planned reps or time.

0006.description: Lying on your back, you crunch sideways to reach each hand toward its heel in turn. Works the obliques and abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulders off the ground and reach your right hand towards your right heel.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the left side, reaching your left hand towards your left heel.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双臂伸直至两侧，与地面平行。
收紧腹肌，将肩膀抬离地面，并将右手伸向右脚跟。
返回起始位置并在左侧重复，将左手伸向左脚跟。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0070.description: A curl with the upper arms resting on a preacher pad, which keeps the focus on the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad and your chest against the support.
Grasp the barbell with an underhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师凳上，上臂放在垫子上，胸部靠在支撑物上。
反手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0134.description: A push-up with the knees bent and turned to one side, adding a gentle twist to the trunk. It trains the chest and the obliques.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your knees bent and both hands under your shoulders.
Rotate your knees and hips slightly to one side.
Lower your chest to the floor with your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up to the start.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Switch the side of your knees between sets.

0198.description: A classic seated cable pulldown with a wide bar. You pull to the chest to train the lats and the muscles around the shoulder blades.
instructions: Adjust the cable pulldown machine so that the seat is at a comfortable height and the knee pad is secured.
Sit on the seat with your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the cable bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and engage your core.
Pull the cable bar down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整拉索下拉机，使座椅处于舒适的高度并固定护膝。
坐在座位上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住电缆杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
稍微向后倾斜并启动你的核心。
将电缆杆向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开杠铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0262.description: A crunch where you rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee. It targets the abs and the obliques.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground and twist to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，然后扭转，使右肘靠近左膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复，将左肘靠近右膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。

0326.description: A chest-supported rear lateral raise on an incline bench. It isolates the rear delts and the upper back.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your chest against the backrest and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Extend your arms straight down with your palms facing each other.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，胸部靠在靠背上，双手各握一个哑铃。
双臂伸直向下，手掌相对。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0390.description: You curl dumbbells while sitting on a stability ball. It works the biceps and challenges your balance and core.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbells while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0454.description: Chest down on an incline bench, you curl an EZ bar from a hanging position. It isolates the biceps with a strict range.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Rest your upper arms on a preacher bench or stability ball, allowing your elbows to hang down.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂放在牧师凳或稳定球上，让肘部下垂。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0518.description: You alternately clean a kettlebell from a hang to the rack position. It works the hips, back, shoulders and grip.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Allow the kettlebells to hang in front of your body with your arms fully extended.
In one fluid motion, explosively extend your hips, shrug your shoulders, and pull the kettlebells up towards your shoulders.
As the kettlebells reach shoulder height, rotate your wrists and catch the kettlebells in the rack position, with your palms facing inward and the kettlebells resting on the outside of your forearms.
Lower the kettlebells back down to the starting position and repeat the movement with the opposite arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个壶铃，正手握住。
稍微弯曲膝盖，臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
让壶铃悬挂在身体前方，双臂完全伸展。
以一种流畅的动作，爆发性地伸展臀部，耸肩，并将壶铃拉向肩膀。
当壶铃到达肩膀高度时，旋转手腕并将壶铃抓住在架子位置，手掌朝内，壶铃放在前臂外侧。
将壶铃放回起始位置，然后用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

0582.description: Kneeling on a machine, you curl your lower legs up against a pad. Isolates the hamstrings.
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight.
Kneel on the machine facing downwards, with your knees resting on the pad and your feet secured under the footpads.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position, fully extending your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整机器以适合您的身体并选择所需的重量。
面朝下跪在机器上，膝盖放在垫子上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
抓住机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
保持上半身静止，呼气，弯曲膝盖，将双腿向臀肌方向卷起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的腿筋。
吸气，慢慢将双腿放回起始位置，充分伸展膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。

0710.description: Standing on one leg, you lift the other leg out to the side. Works the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight to one leg and lift the opposite leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手放在臀部。
将重心转移到一条腿上，并将另一条腿向一侧抬起，保持伸直。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0774.description: A standing overhead press with the smith bar, starting at shoulder height. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it down to shoulder level, with your palms facing forward.
Press the barbell upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其降至与肩同高，手掌朝前。
向上推杠铃，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

0838.description: A side-lying neck raise using a head harness with a weight. It builds strength in the muscles at the side of the neck.
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench with your head just past the edge, wearing a head harness with a light weight.
Let your head hang slightly toward the floor.
Lift your head up toward the ceiling, moving only your neck.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
Use a light weight and a controlled pace.

0902.description: A hyperextension with band resistance. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Secure the band over your shoulders and under your feet or anchor.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Rise until your torso is in line with your legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and repeat.

0966.description: The barbell deadlift shown from behind. It's a full posterior chain lift for the glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
